sources.title: Running AI Models - Supabase Docs
sources.snippet: Edge Functions have a built-in API for running AI models. You can use this API to generate embeddings, build conversational workflows, and do other AI related tasks in your Edge Functions. This allows you to: Generate text embeddings without external dependencies Run Large Language Models via Ollama or Llamafile Build conversational AI workflows
